_how_to_use_this_file: Copy it, rename it <suite>--<model>--<your-handle>.json, fill it in, open a pull request. Or open the 'Submit a result' issue and paste it there and it gets filed for you. Everything below marked required has to be real; a field you cannot fill honestly is left out, never guessed.
hardware: Apple M4 Pro, 48 GB unified memory
notes: Anything that would change how someone reads the number. Thermal throttling, a prompt you had to change, items you skipped and why.
_rules: One file per run. Do not average several runs into one file.
Name the hardware exactly, including memory. A number without a machine is not a result.
Only metrics listed for that suite in suites/registry.json, by their exact names.
If you cannot share the log, say so in notes. The row gets marked unverified, not dropped.
Vendor-published numbers do not belong here. Those go in the reported section, with the source.
